title: Salinity state, solute mass owner, and root-stress migration
current_finding: Canonical SWAP5 remains without an admitted solute owner or salinity response. This work branch adds independently testable local prototypes for conservative mobile salt mass with explicit upwind advection and the Maas-Hoffman response. The salt prototype does not yet bind to the accepted runtime/restart path and omits dispersion/substeps; Jarvis remains fail-closed for salinity.
historical_reconstruction: Source-family evidence distinguishes Maas-Hoffman switch 1 as a nodewise alpha(CML) from osmotic-head switch 2, which modifies matric-flux potential and requires Jong-van-Lier drought; switch 2 is not a separate multiplicative alpha_sol. Source-family census additionally establishes SWINCO-dependent initial versus warm-restart concentration profiles, CMSY inventory derived from water content/CML and optional Freundlich sorption, explicit boundary and drainage fluxes, internal solute substeps, and root salt uptake TSCF*qrot*CML. Exact B1.11 solute-member and restart details remain unverified in this execution.
dependency_surface: B1.11 solute transport/state source and restart lifecycle
accepted Bartholomeus oxygen composition and application/persistence routes
interfaces_allowed_to_change: new bounded typed solute-state owner and independent salinity-response interface after contract checkpoint
next_action: Implement the selected optional salt component and independent template/restart layout identity across all FMR clone paths, preserving disabled-only v2 restart compatibility. Then bind salt transport to accepted Richards substeps, qualify dispersion/timestep semantics, expose matching concentration views, and integrate Maas-Hoffman into D2 only after these gates pass.
blockers: Exact B1.11 solute-state/restart text is not materialized. D1 records provenance search exhausted; no further search is warranted without a new authorized raw-byte route.
Canonical runtime/restart has no salt-state owner; the current module is a pure trial transformation and is not an accepted production transaction.

FMR represents optional physical continuations through explicit clone families and template-layout cases. A salinity state must define coexistence with these families and preserve salinity-disabled layouts before changing production state interfaces.

Prototype is explicit advective upwind only, with no dispersive flux, internal timestep substeps, drainage, boundary schedule, or restart serialization. These remain separate physical/numerical acceptance gates.
recovery_point: PPA-WU05-E has restricted E1 and E2 local prototypes on the work branch. Focused O0/O2 salinity tests pass against the current postimage. A source-backed runtime transaction/restart audit establishes that kernel commit and Restart v2 each own one physical state object and that FMR restart layout is explicitly discriminated. The branch has selected an optional typed salt component plus an independent template/restart layout identity; this design is proposed, not canonically accepted or implemented. No Jarvis interface was changed and no salinity capability is qualified/admitted. Exact B1.11 solute-member bytes, common-state/clone/restart implementation, and live accepted-substep transport binding remain open.

source_family_census.initialization: SWINCO != 3 interpolates ZC/CML input to nodes; SWINCO = 3 consumes a warm-start concentration profile and does not reapply the initial table (source-family only).
source_family_census.state: CML is mobile-water concentration; CMSY is dissolved plus adsorbed mass per bulk soil volume; column inventory integrates CMSY over node thickness.
source_family_census.transport: Surface input, inter-node advective/dispersive flux, bottom exchange, lateral drainage, root uptake, optional decomposition; internal solute substeps.
source_family_census.root_salt_uptake: TSCF*qrot*CML is a solute-mass sink; must use the same candidate/accepted qrot as the one root-water sink.
source_family_census.ownership: Dedicated solute-state owner advances candidate salt mass and commits/rolls it back with the physical transaction; Jarvis reads concentration only.
source_family_census.exact_source_limit: All equations and lifecycle details above are source-family corroboration only, not byte-exact B1.11 claims.

initial_e1_envelope: One conservative dissolved salt constituent in mobile water; SWSP=0; decomposition, macropore, ageing, aquifer mixing, MICRO and lateral drainage off; explicit top/bottom solute boundary traces; root salt uptake through TSCF*qrot*CML with restricted 0<=TSCF<=1; node salt mass authoritative, CML derived from matching committed/trial water content; paired water/salt trial commit/discard.
